name: Tic-Tac-Toe
summary: Tic-tac-toe, the game that ends the film. WOPR never loses, so the best you can do is a draw.
howToPlay: At PLEASE LIST NUMBER OF PLAYERS: type 1 to play WOPR, 2 for two people at one keyboard, or 0 to watch WOPR play itself.
You are X and move first. Type a square from 1 to 9, numbered left to right from the top row.
Three in a row wins. A full board with no line is a draw.

controls.does: at the players prompt: play WOPR, play a friend, or let WOPR play itself
take the top-left square; columns A to C, rows 1 to 3
leave the game and go back to WOPR

tips: Before each move, check whether WOPR has two in a row, and block it.
Open in a corner. The only safe answer is the centre.
Try 0 players to see what WOPR learns from playing itself.

screenshots.caption: The empty board shows each square's number.
Square 3 is taken, so WOPR asks again. A1 names the top-left square.
A full board with no line: WINNER: NONE.
